items.text: Yoshino → Nara (no guide; train times from Jorudan, verify)
Morning service in the Zaō-dō (visitors may attend), ~15 min walk down.
Breakfast at Chikurinin (enter 7:00–8:00, time to confirm). Public bath 6:00–9:00. Check-out by 10:00.
Leave Chikurinin with the small bags and walk down the main street.
Opens 8:30. ¥800, or ~¥1,600 if the hidden Zaō Gongen are on show. Cash. 📿 stamp.
Back up the main street to the Yoshimizu side lane.
Gate opens 9:00. 'Hitome Senbon' view from the terrace; Shoin ¥600 if time allows.
Down the main street past the copper torii to the ropeway top.
Ropeway Yoshinoyama → Senbonguchi (cash; daily until 30 Nov), then 2 min walk to Yoshino Stn.
Kintetsu Yoshino Line Yoshino → Kashiharajingu-mae (arr. 11:00), change.

Kintetsu Limited Express Kashiharajingu-mae → Yamato-Saidaiji (arr. 11:27; LE ticket ¥520), then express 11:34 → Kintetsu-Nara (arr. 11:40). ¥1,550 pp in total (¥1,030 without the LE, arriving 11:50).
Nara (self-guided)
Kintetsu-Nara → Naramachi via Sarusawa Pond.
Lunch: kakinoha-zushi (persimmon-leaf sushi). Look for the red monkey charms.
North to Sarusawa Pond and up the 52 steps.
⚠️ Pagoda fully covered (repairs until ~2031). Halls 9:00–17:00; National Treasure Museum (Ashura) ¥900 is the pick.
To Yoshikien.
Free for foreign visitors: show passports. Last entry 16:30.
Walk through towards Nandaimon; crackers only, empty hands when done.
Nandaimon guardians, Great Buddha (¥800, cash), the nostril pillar. 📿 stamp.
Rain backup: Buddhist Sculpture Hall (¥700, open Thursdays, last entry 16:30).
Tōdai-ji → Kasuga Taisha through the park and the lantern path.
Special worship (inner corridor, ¥700) until 16:00: go there first. Fujinami-no-ya lantern hall. 📿 stamp.
North uphill past the Wakakusa-yama gate to Nigatsu-dō.
Free, 24 h. Sunset ~16:50 over the Daibutsuden roof.
Instead of Nigatsu-dō, not both: ¥150, gates close 17:00.
Nara → Osaka
Nigatsu-dō → Kintetsu-Nara (dark lanes: phone torch).
Kintetsu Nara Line express Kintetsu-Nara → Osaka-Namba (arr. ~18:30; verify arrival and fare ~¥680). The 17:05 is too tight.

First luggage option: collect the 2 suitcases at Yamato Namba Station Center (4-4-4 Namba; handover until 20:00 per Yamato's list, verify), passport + tracking number. Second option: they wait at Nishinari Tamade Post Office (collect Fri 20 morning).
Osaka Metro Yotsubashi Line Namba → Tamade, then 3 min walk.
Self check-in at Hanastay Aya (from 15:00), Tamade-naka 2-8-16. No waiting for any delivery.
Tamade → Daikokuchō → Dōbutsuen-mae.
Kushikatsu dinner in Shinsekai. No double-dipping.
Fallback if too tired: dinner in Namba (no fixed place) or near the stay in Tamade (Sumibi-yakitori Kitcho, Toridan, Yoro no Taki).
Dōbutsuen-mae → Daikokuchō → Tamade.
